/**************************\
  Basic Modal Styles
\**************************/

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
}

.modal__btn {
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  padding-right: 1rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  background-color: #e6e6e6;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  border-radius: .25rem;
  border-style: none;
  border-width: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  text-transform: none;
  overflow: visible;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0;
  will-change: transform;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.modal__btn-primary {
  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;
}

    from { opacity: 0; }

}

@keyframes mmfadeOut {
    from { opacity: 1; }

@keyframes mmslideIn {

    to { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes mmslideOut {
    from { transform: translateY(0); }

.micromodal-slide {
  display: none;

.micromodal-slide.is-open {
  display: block;

  animation: mmfadeIn .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideIn .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeOut .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideOut .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);

  padding-top: 0px; /* Location of the box */
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 300%; /* Full width */
  height: 300%; /* Full height */

}

/* Modal Content */
.modal-content {
  margin: auto;
  padding: 20px;
  width: 80%;
	display: inline-grid;
}

  float: right;
  font-size: 28px;

/**************************\
  Basic Modal Styles
\**************************/

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
}

.modal__btn {
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  padding-right: 1rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  background-color: #e6e6e6;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  border-radius: .25rem;
  border-style: none;
  border-width: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  text-transform: none;
  overflow: visible;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0;
  will-change: transform;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.modal__btn-primary {
  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;
}



/**************************\

@keyframes mmfadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes mmfadeOut {
    from { opacity: 1; }
      to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes mmslideIn {
  from { transform: translateY(15%); }
    to { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes mmslideOut {
    from { transform: translateY(0); }
    to { transform: translateY(-10%); }
}

.micromodal-slide {
  display: none;
}

.micromodal-slide.is-open {
  display: block;
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeIn .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideIn .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeOut .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideOut .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide .modal__container,
.micromodal-slide .modal__overlay {
  will-change: transform;

/**************************\

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;

  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;

  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;

  text-transform: none;

  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;

  left: 0;
  top: 0;

/**************************\
  Basic Modal Styles
\**************************/

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
}

.modal__btn {
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  padding-right: 1rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  background-color: #e6e6e6;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  border-radius: .25rem;
  border-style: none;
  border-width: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  text-transform: none;
  overflow: visible;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0;
  will-change: transform;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.modal__btn-primary {
  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;
}



/**************************\

\**************************/
@keyframes mmfadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes mmfadeOut {
    from { opacity: 1; }
      to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes mmslideIn {
  from { transform: translateY(15%); }
    to { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes mmslideOut {
    from { transform: translateY(0); }
    to { transform: translateY(-10%); }
}

.micromodal-slide {
  display: none;
}

.micromodal-slide.is-open {
  display: block;
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeIn .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideIn .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeOut .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideOut .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide .modal__container,
.micromodal-slide .modal__overlay {
  will-change: transform;

/**************************\

\**************************/

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
}

.modal__btn {
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;

  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  background-color: #e6e6e6;

  border-style: none;
  border-width: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  text-transform: none;
  overflow: visible;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0;
  will-change: transform;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.modal__btn-primary {
  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;
}

<p><strong>Précisions sur les tarif de recharge – Grenoble-Alpes Métropole</strong></p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Les prix indiqués sont des prix TTC.</li>



<li>Tout kWh entamé est dû.</li>



<li>Toute tranche de 30 min entamée est due.</li>



<li>La tarification appliquée est indiquée sur chaque borne concernée.</li>



<li>Les bornes ont une puissance de 22 kW  et 7 kW en voirie et de 7 kW dans les parking relais. La puissance est indiquée sur la borne. Cependant, tous les véhicules électriques ne peuvent se recharger à la puissance maximale de la borne: renseignez-vous sur la puissance maximale à laquelle votre véhicule peut charger.</li>



<li>Les bornes sont accessibles avec d’autres badges que le badge OùRA!, mais ce au tarif non abonné. Des frais supplémentaires peuvent être appliqués par votre opérateur de mobilité, Grenoble-Alpes Métropole ne peut en être tenue pour responsable.</li>



<li>Des bornes sont également accessibles dans la plupart des parkings en ouvrage P-GAM avec le badge OùRA!</li>
</ul>



<p><strong>L’auto-partage – Grenoble-Alpes Métropole</strong></p>



<p>La Métropole soutient l’auto-partage, notamment électrique, et dédie certains points de charge à l’auto-partage : ces points de charge sont à l’usage exclusif des usagers de l’auto-partage.</p>



<p><strong>Tarif spécial pour les taxis Grenoblois</strong></p>



<p>Certaines bornes installées sont dédiées aux Taxis Grenoblois ayant droit. Avant toute demande, renseignez-vous auprès de vos responsables afin de connaître la démarche à suivre. </p>



<p>Puis, si vous souhaitez bénéficier des avantages liés aux bornes dédiées aux Taxis Grenoblois, merci de réaliser votre demande de souscription à ce service via le formulaire de contact : <a href="http://support.alizecharge.com/support/tickets/new" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener"><strong>notre formulaire en ligne</strong></a></p>

  position: absolute; /* Stay in place */

  padding-top: 0px; /* Location of the box */
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 300%; /* Full width */
  height: 300%; /* Full height */

}

/* Modal Content */
.modal-content {
  margin: auto;
  padding: 20px;
  width: 80%;
	display: inline-grid;

.close {

  float: right;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.close:focus {
  color: #000;

/**************************\
  Basic Modal Styles
\**************************/

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
}

.modal__btn {
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  padding-right: 1rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  background-color: #e6e6e6;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  border-radius: .25rem;
  border-style: none;
  border-width: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  text-transform: none;
  overflow: visible;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0;
  will-change: transform;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.modal__btn-primary {
  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;
}



/**************************\
  Demo Animation Style
\**************************/
@keyframes mmfadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes mmfadeOut {
    from { opacity: 1; }
      to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes mmslideIn {
  from { transform: translateY(15%); }
    to { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes mmslideOut {
    from { transform: translateY(0); }
    to { transform: translateY(-10%); }
}

.micromodal-slide {
  display: none;
}

.micromodal-slide.is-open {
  display: block;
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeIn .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideIn .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeOut .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideOut .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide .modal__container,
.micromodal-slide .modal__overlay {
  will-change: transform;

.modal {
  display: none; /* Hidden by default */
  position: absolute; /* Stay in place */
  z-index: 1; /* Sit on top */
  padding-top: 0px; /* Location of the box */
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 300%; /* Full width */
  height: 300%; /* Full height */

}

/* Modal Content */
.modal-content {
  margin: auto;
  padding: 20px;
  width: 80%;
	display: inline-grid;
}

/* The Close Button */
.close {
  color: #aaaaaa;
  float: right;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.close:hover,
.close:focus {
  color: #000;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/**************************\
  Basic Modal Styles
\**************************/

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
}

.modal__btn {
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  padding-right: 1rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  background-color: #e6e6e6;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  border-radius: .25rem;
  border-style: none;
  border-width: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  text-transform: none;
  overflow: visible;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0;
  will-change: transform;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.modal__btn-primary {
  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;
}



/**************************\
  Demo Animation Style
\**************************/
@keyframes mmfadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes mmfadeOut {
    from { opacity: 1; }
      to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes mmslideIn {
  from { transform: translateY(15%); }
    to { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes mmslideOut {
    from { transform: translateY(0); }
    to { transform: translateY(-10%); }
}

.micromodal-slide {
  display: none;
}

.micromodal-slide.is-open {
  display: block;
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeIn .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideIn .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeOut .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideOut .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide .modal__container,
.micromodal-slide .modal__overlay {
  will-change: transform;
}

/**************************\
  Basic Modal Styles
\**************************/

.modal {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,avenir next,avenir,helvetica neue,helvetica,ubuntu,roboto,noto,segoe ui,arial,sans-serif;
}

.modal__overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__container {
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 30px;
  max-width: 500px;
  max-height: 100vh;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.modal__title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: #00449e;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.modal__close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.modal__header .modal__close:before { content: "\2715"; }

.modal__content {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
}

.modal__btn {
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  padding-right: 1rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  background-color: #e6e6e6;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  border-radius: .25rem;
  border-style: none;
  border-width: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  text-transform: none;
  overflow: visible;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0;
  will-change: transform;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: -webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out;
  transition: transform .25s ease-out,-webkit-transform .25s ease-out;
}

.modal__btn:focus, .modal__btn:hover {
  -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.modal__btn-primary {
  background-color: #00449e;
  color: #fff;
}



/**************************\
  Demo Animation Style
\**************************/
@keyframes mmfadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes mmfadeOut {
    from { opacity: 1; }
      to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes mmslideIn {
  from { transform: translateY(15%); }
    to { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes mmslideOut {
    from { transform: translateY(0); }
    to { transform: translateY(-10%); }
}

.micromodal-slide {
  display: none;
}

.micromodal-slide.is-open {
  display: block;
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeIn .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="false"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideIn .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__overlay {
  animation: mmfadeOut .3s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide[aria-hidden="true"] .modal__container {
  animation: mmslideOut .3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1);
}

.micromodal-slide .modal__container,
.micromodal-slide .modal__overlay {
  will-change: transform;
}
